_comment: Dev-triage → arbitration summary (DESIGN §1.23.2). Posted mechanically after the developer triages the round-1 issues. AGREED/REJECTED sections come from render.build_triage_section_paragraphs (empty side vanishes); ESCALATE_INSTRUCTION_PARAGRAPHS is passed only when review.triage == "simple".

content.text: 请裁决开发者的处理意见:
· 回复 "ok" 同意（有待修复问题时通知开发者修复；全部无需修复时直接批准）
· 回复问题序号（如 2 4）将对应异议问题重新列入修复
· 回复 "close" 或 "关闭" 终止MR
